machineDoctor.intro: One read-only scan across everything the app can check - pin conflicts, driver values, config drift, project lint, firmware sync, hardware changes, and install health - graded A-F. Every finding links to the widget that fixes it.
machineDoctor.scoreHint: A weighted blend of the pillars below. Health checks (config integrity, firmware sync, services) score what we could measure - config integrity loses 25 per error and 8 per warning. Setup steps you haven't run yet (input shaping, max flow, motor drivers) count as zero until done, so finishing them raises the score. Signals we can't read right now don't count against you.
machineDoctor.notChecked: Could not be checked (printer unreachable or no baseline).

assessment.healthy: Healthy - everything the app can check looks good and setup is complete.
assessment.setup_incomplete: Nothing broken, but setup isn't finished yet - {pillars} still to run.
assessment.clean_but_findings: Nothing broken, but there are {warnings} warning(s) to clear.

readiness.title: Setup readiness
readiness.banner: Setup isn't finished - the unrun steps count as zero and are holding the score down. Run them to raise it.

pins.double_assign: Pin {pin} on {mcu} is assigned in more than one section.
pins.caveat: Pin {pin} on {mcu} carries an electronics caveat.

drivers.over_driver_cap: {section}: run_current {run_current} A exceeds the ~{cap} A driver ceiling.
drivers.near_driver_cap: {section}: run_current {run_current} A is within 10% of the ~{cap} A ceiling.
drivers.over_motor_rating: {section}: run_current {run_current} A exceeds the {motor} rating ({max_current} A).
drivers.near_motor_rating: {section}: run_current {run_current} A is within 10% of the {motor} rating ({max_current} A).
drivers.odd_microsteps: {section}: microsteps {microsteps} is not a power of two.

drift.pending: Klipper has unsaved SAVE_CONFIG changes pending.

project.orphan_driver: {file}: driver section "{message}" has no matching stepper.

hardware.no_baseline: No hardware baseline saved yet - save a snapshot in the Machine Map to detect changes.

steps: Press Rescan to run one read-only check across the whole printer.
Read the A-F grade and the pillar bars to see where it's weakest.
Open any finding's link to jump straight to the widget that fixes it.

scan.title: What the scan covers
scan.body: One read-only pass over everything the app can check - pin conflicts, driver values, config drift between the saved and live config, project lint, firmware sync, hardware changes vs your baseline, and install health. It never runs anything on the printer.

grade.title: The A-F grade
grade.body: The score blends two things. Health checks (config integrity, firmware sync, services) score what we could measure. Setup steps - input shaping, max flow and motor-driver tuning - count as zero until you run them, so a printer that hasn't been tuned scores low even if nothing is broken, and each step you finish raises the number. The letter grade follows straight from that score, and a signal we can't read right now (Moonraker or the host offline) simply drops out instead of counting against you.

fixes.title: Jump-to-fix links
fixes.body: Every finding carries a button that deep-links into the widget that resolves it (Config Editor, Motor Drivers, the Machine Map…), so you go from problem to fix in one click.

grade.def: A single letter summarizing the printer's health, derived from the pillar scores; A is healthy, F needs attention.

pillar.def: A health category scored independently - e.g. config integrity, firmware sync, services, input shaping, max flow.

finding.def: A specific issue the scan detected, with its severity and a link to the widget that fixes it.
